Start a new KIT Shiny app

Source: R/new_app.R
kit_new_app.Rd

Creates a ready-to-run app package skeleton, with one example tab written to the KIT design language's page skeleton:

Usage

kit_new_app(
  path,
  title,
  subtitle = "臺灣幼兒發展調查資料庫",
  package = basename(path)
)

Arguments

path

The new folder (the last part is the package name, e.g. "~/kitScore").

title

The tool name, e.g. "KIT 計分工具" ("KIT scoring tool").

subtitle

The subtitle, e.g. "臺灣幼兒發展調查資料庫" (the KIT database).

package

The package name (defaults to the folder name): starts with a letter and contains only letters, digits, and periods.

Value

path (full path), invisibly.

Details

  • DESCRIPTION: Imports: kitDesign (>= current version), Remotes: jiewenTsai/kitDesign@v<current version>.

  • app.R: the entry point for Posit Connect Cloud (primary file).

  • R/app.R: kit_page() plus the step tabs module (kit_step_tabs_ui()); run_app().

  • R/page_calc.R: an example tab using a primary button plus the ready line (kit_run_gate_ui()), a status box, a result table, "How to do it in R" (kit_code_panel_ui()), and next step.

  • tests/testthat/: one shiny::testServer() test.

  • .gitignore (including tests/testthat/_problems/ and testthat-problems.rds), .Rbuildignore, README.md, LICENSE.

If the folder already exists and is not empty, it does nothing and stops (it never overwrites any file).

Examples

dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "kitDemo")
kit_new_app(dir, "KIT 示範工具", "臺灣幼兒發展調查資料庫")  # "KIT demo tool", the KIT database
list.files(dir, recursive = TRUE)
#> [1] "DESCRIPTION"               "LICENSE"                  
#> [3] "NAMESPACE"                 "R/app.R"                  
#> [5] "R/page_calc.R"             "README.md"                
#> [7] "app.R"                     "tests/testthat.R"         
#> [9] "tests/testthat/test-app.R"
unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE)
